description: Comfortable and lightweight, this Patriotic T-Shirt features an American Flag graphic and is accompanied by the phrase “This Is My Flag”. The American flag shirt features a branded Rothco “R” on the left sleeve and a reverse distressed US flag graphic on the right sleeve. The USA flag shirt is designed with a tagless printed label for added comfort.
